span.p:
Input-mode policy:
• Specific exact region is the DEFAULT input (PLC-001) — ACRME validates it.
• Geography-only selection is EXCEPTIONAL (PLC-002) — requires explicit exception
approval + customer acknowledgement that the derived Prod region becomes the
fixed seed until an approved migration changes it.
